notes.title: Demo Update
notes.notes: [p]Hi all![/p][p][/p][p]Thank you all for playing the Isles Of Rain Demo. This small update brings some changes based on feedback.[/p][p][/p][p]Notes:[/p][list][*][p]Camera Vertical Movement will now stay where you move it to[/p][/*][*][p]Camera will now only collide with specific objects rather than everything[/p][/*][*][p]Added more variety of music to the game[/p][/*][*][p]Re-balanced all sound effects and audio[/p][/*][*][p]Picking up marbles will now only show the dialogue prompt once[/p][/*][*][p]Overlay will now properly display cold or warm state rather than flash when cold[/p][/*][*][p]Made it a bit more obvious that the houses can be entered[/p][/*][/list][p][/p][p]Please continue to provide any feedback and suggestions![/p][p][/p]
